Drop images here or click to choose PNG · JPEG · WebP · up to 10 images · 20 MiB each · 50 MiB total

References are attached to the prompt at High effort. Each generation gets the same images; they are deleted from this machine when the job settles (kept only for an unknown outcome until the retention sweep).

A batch requests N outputs; it does not guarantee simultaneous rendering. The configured maximum and your provider limits still apply.

For ChatGPT browser mode, this is not a native High/Medium/Low model setting. The gateway cannot guarantee render quality. Original images are preserved byte-for-byte.

Queuing is asynchronous: the selected account picks the job up on its next dispatch slot under the configured caps.

Generation uses an unofficial third-party browser gateway, subject to provider availability and service terms. No quota bypass or automatic rate-limit rotation.

SYSTEM / 08

Settings.

Runtime checks, installation instructions and integration.

Runtime environment

Gateway installation

Run once on your own computer. New accounts can then be created in the web panel automatically.

SETUP COMMAND
python scripts/prepare_gateway.py
START THE PANEL
python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
The gateway is an experimental third-party adapter. Automated ChatGPT access is against OpenAI's Terms of Use. The safest production option is an official image API.

Agent endpoint

Use AGENT_API_KEY as a Bearer token. POST creates an asynchronous job; GET polls its status. Account ID must be specified explicitly. 

POST /v1/images/generations
Authorization: Bearer <AGENT_API_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account_id": "<account UUID>",
  "prompt": "A neon samurai in the rain",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
}

GET /v1/jobs/<job UUID>
ACCOUNT SETUP

Add an account

Create an isolated worker. Then click Login to connect your own ChatGPT account manually.

Existing accounts

0

Status, plan, session and project are detected automatically from each signed-in ChatGPT account — nothing to type manually.

Create a ChatGPT project named “Ninja Image Hub”, open it and paste the address-bar URL here. New generations for this account then appear inside that project instead of the normal chat list. Project links are per-account; apply with Stop → Start.

Effective parallelism is also capped by Gateway tabs and the global dispatcher. This does not increase provider quota. Changes apply to future jobs.

ACCOUNT DETAILS

Account
ACCOUNT LOGIN

Connect account

Three ways to sign in. Pick whichever is easiest; all of them end in the same saved session on the worker.

Identity: not checked yet

1 · Remote login page works everywhere

Streams the server-side browser; click and type inside it. Use this on a Linux server or whenever no browser window is visible.

2 · Visible browser window desktop only

On Windows/macOS/Linux-desktop the worker Chrome window is already open. Sign in there (Chrome profile stays on this machine), then refresh the account status.

3 · Automatic login optional

Stores credentials for this account only, so the gateway can sign in again when the session expires. Saved under the account data directory with file mode 0600; the panel never shows them again. Use a dedicated account.

Not configured.

Applying a change needs a worker restart: Stop → Start this account. The gateway then signs in by itself on startup and after session expiry.
